svg.title: Scan pollution: LRU vs LFU
svg.desc: Two grids of 50 squares, each square about 100 hot keys. 40,000 one-off keys are then written into the full cache. With allkeys-lru the one-off keys replace almost every hot square, leaving 162 of 5,000 hot keys. With allkeys-lfu the one-off keys, accessed once, are evicted first and all 5,000 hot keys stay. For comparison, allkeys-random kept 1,178.
svg.text: 5,000 hot keys are read 5 times each, then 40,000 one-off keys are written into the full 20 MB cache.
Each new key is the most recently used,
so it pushes out a hot key.
Each square is about 100 keys. allkeys-random kept 1,178.
